info.title: Go crypto module with bcrypt support

diffs.patch:
Index: go.sum
===================================================================
--- go.sum	
+++ go.sum	
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0 h1:3ZVCjf8Ggz7zneR/EHRVx68Ctf+2pmIMP2UFhh9cC6M=
+golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0/go.mod h1:Fdz0i5U6CoizGwLda9DttjSk6qlZo25zYNtR+ycvuZA=

Index: main.go
===================================================================
--- main.go	
+++ main.go	
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	"example.com/app/auth"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	password := "correct horse battery staple"
+	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
+		password = os.Args[1]
+	}
+
+	hash, err := auth.HashPassword(password)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "hash:", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+	fmt.Println("hash:", hash)
+
+	ok, err := auth.CheckPassword(password, hash)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "check:", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+	fmt.Println("password valid:", ok)
+
+	ok, err = auth.CheckPassword("wrong password", hash)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "check:", err)
+		os.Exit(1)
+	}
+	fmt.Println("wrong password valid:", ok)
+}

Done. Set up a Go module using `golang.org/x/crypto` for bcrypt.

- `go.mod` — module `example.com/app`, requires `golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0`
- `auth/password.go` — `HashPassword` / `CheckPassword` wrappers around bcrypt (`DefaultCost`)
- `main.go` — demo: hash, verify correct password, reject wrong one

Verified with `go build`, `go vet`, `gofmt`, and a successful run. Note: I installed Go 1.27.1 to `~/.local/go` (added to `~/.bashrc`), and used `example.com/app` as the placeholder module path — rename it if you have a real repo path.
